resolutionsNotes.tmp@^0.0.33: GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6 (`<0.2.6`, path traversal via an unsanitized prefix/postfix) and GHSA-898m-9v49-8vgq (`<=0.2.3`). `external-editor` (via @changesets/cli) declares `tmp@^0.0.33`, and a caret on a `0.0.x` version is semver-equivalent to `=0.0.33`, so `yarn up -R` cannot move it -- it needs this override. 0.2.6 is the minimum that clears both advisories; the scanner's suggested 0.2.4 only clears the second. external-editor calls `tmp.tmpNameSync()` and nothing else, which 0.2.x still exports. Reachable only through `yarn changeset`'s interactive editor prompt, never at chart render or release time. Drop once external-editor widens its range.
